The same torn orange woven outfit over dark navy cloth, blue sash, wrist wraps and boots; every existing tear and stain stays. Real skin, real fabric, real atmospheric light. The external light never becomes a solid flat flame graphic, and does not hide the body or landscape. 4.6–5.8 seconds: the yell releases into exhalation, jaw closes and chin returns toward the controlled reference angle. 5.8–6.58 seconds: ordinary irises and dark pupils reopen, reaching the exact human face and controlled stance of Picture 2 while breathing, fine hair, cloth, dust and a few electrical arcs continue to move.
